summary: Validated iter-29 security fixes SEC-001 (dev-login host guard), SEC-002 (customer RBAC), SEC-003 (short-lived dt_ download tokens). Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass. Frontend Playwright smoke on phone viewport confirms /reports, /po and /import (admin) all mint a dt_ token via POST /api/auth/download-token and open the export URL with `?token=dt_...` (no raw session token in URL). Site engineer hitting Customer Master shows 'Customer directory is restricted to management roles.' and MRF flow remains usable. No code changes required.
critical_code_review_comments: SEC-001 dev_login_blocked audit rows are inserted with a `try/except: pass` — this is fine but silent DB failures would go unlogged. Consider a warning log on exception.

SEC-003 export endpoints still accept the legacy raw session token via `?token=` for backward compat. This is intentional per the review request but should be scheduled for removal once all download call sites are on dt_ tokens (verified today: reports MRF/PO, /po export, /import vendor+MRF templates all use dt_).
seed_data_creation: None. Dev-login used for role tokens; existing customers/MRFs used for RBAC checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEC-001/002/003 verified. test_iter29_security.py covers: dev-login host guard (localhost + preview allowed; production host header pair blocked with 404 + audit row), customer RBAC (site_engineer & store blocked on list/detail/attachment; pm/purchase/gm/director/admin allowed on list), dt_ tokens (mint shape, single-use enforced via 401 'already used', dt_ works as ?token= on export/mrf XLSX, legacy raw session token still works on both header + query, TTL index on download_tokens.expires_at exists). Frontend: window.open captured URLs — all export/download call sites use dt_ tokens.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this is a validation task, not a bug fix. All three security fixes behave as designed.
